documents.title: GRC Professional Workday Analysis — August 1 OSINT Sweep
documents.executiveSummary: Ironintel and Ironwatch live OSINT for August 1, 2026 pivots from July 31 deadline convergence to BOD 26-04 deadline-day execution on Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center CVE-2026-20316 (static hard-coded credentials, actively exploited zero-day, CISA KEV July 29) — FCEB agencies must apply branch-specific hotfixes and complete forensics triage per BOD 26-04 before close of business today. Minnesota water PLC coordinated campaign enters day five of statewide MNIT response with CISA July 31 nationwide alert urging removal of internet-exposed PLCs per Advisory AA26-097A; federal investigators continue evaluating Iranian-affiliated attribution alignment. Cl0p ransomware affiliates escalate PTC Windchill/FlexPLM CVE-2026-12569 (CVSS 9.3 unauthenticated RCE, KEV June 25) extortion wave with July 20+ emails targeting aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, and retail PLM estates — first-ever PTC product on KEV catalog with confirmed JSP webshell deployment. CMMC Phase II C3PAO suspension enters day 19 of 60-day Reform Task Force review (report due September 11; industry RFI closes August 14); Phase I NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 self-assessments remain binding under DFARS 252.204-7012. Post-deadline verification window opens for Balbooa Forms CVE-2026-56291 (July 31 FCEB deadline passed), Arista VeloCloud CVE-2026-16812 (July 30), and AD FS CVE-2026-56155 (July 28) — Ironwatch requires attestation receipts before closing KEV tickets.
keyFindings: BOD 26-04 deadline day August 1, 2026 — Cisco Secure FMC CVE-2026-20316 (CISA KEV July 29): Static hard-coded low-privilege credentials actively exploited in zero-day attacks; Cisco PSIRT confirmed exploitation July 2026; CVSS 5.3 escalates when chained with CVE-2026-20079 authentication bypass and CVE-2026-20131 for root access; FCEB must apply branch-specific hotfixes (FMC 7.0 through 10.0) and run IoC check `cat /var/log/messages | grep license` for /var/tmp/license.tmp before returning appliances to service; rotate all credentials, keys, and certificates on suspected compromise per Cisco TAC advisory cisco-sa-fmc-static-cred-BET3Cjh v1.2 (updated July 31) — Technology, Defense, Finance, and Public Sector profiles with internet-exposed FMC management planes require forensic triage today.

Minnesota water PLC coordinated campaign day five (July 26–27 attack, MNIT response active): 30-plus community water systems confirmed malicious OT activity; Braham well and treatment plant offline; Plymouth compromised PLCs at two water towers and 14 sewer lift stations; CISA July 31 alert urges nationwide utilities to disconnect internet-exposed PLCs, replace default passwords, and limit remote access per AA26-097A Add-On Instruction manipulation across Rockwell Allen-Bradley, Schneider Modicon, and Siemens S7-1200 controllers; CI Fortify guidance published July 28 with Five Eyes partners — Public Sector, Manufacturing, and Healthcare facility-management Industry Profiles must inventory OT remote-access paths and attest manual-operations continuity.

Cl0p PTC Windchill/FlexPLM CVE-2026-12569 campaign escalation (July 20–August 1): Critical unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 9.3) in product lifecycle management platforms actively exploited since June 18; Cl0p affiliates chain FlexPLM WSDL information disclosure with Windchill login servlet flaw to deploy hex-named JSP webshells and exfiltrate engineering IP; extortion emails with subject Windchill PDMLink module serious data leak target aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, and retail sectors — first PTC product on CISA KEV catalog; Manufacturing and Defense Industry Profiles must remove internet-exposed Windchill instances and hunt for persistent webshells before closing PLM remediation tickets.

BOD 26-04 post-deadline verification August 1, 2026 — Balbooa Forms CVE-2026-56291 (CVSS 9.8): Unauthenticated file upload to RCE on internet-facing Joomla ecosystem extensions; FCEB deadline passed July 31 — Technology and Public Sector web-application estates must preserve forensic evidence and attest patch or isolation completion before Ironwatch closes remediation tickets.

BOD 26-04 approaching deadlines — Fortinet FortiOS CVE-2025-68686 (KEV added July 27, due August 10): Exposure of sensitive information vulnerability on perimeter appliances; Technology and Public Sector profiles must schedule patch windows before August 10 FCEB deadline alongside WordPress Core CVE-2026-60137 (due August 4).

CareCloud healthcare breach notification carryover (345000 individuals, July 30 AG filings): AWS-hosted EHR exfiltration March 10–16 window — Healthcare Industry Profile must correlate cloud-hosted PHI repository segmentation with OCR and CIRCIA 72-hour reporting obligations alongside TriZetto and NYC Health + Hospitals patterns.

SharePoint July cluster post-deadline carryover: CVE-2026-50522 (watchTowr confirmed exploitation July 20), CVE-2026-58644, and chained CVE-2026-56164 machine-key theft via spinstall0.aspx web shell — IIS machine-key rotation after artifact eviction remains mandatory across Finance, Healthcare, Technology, and Public Sector profiles.

SonicWall SMA zero-day post-deadline forensic verification carryover (CVE-2026-15409/CVE-2026-15410): Volexity UTA0533 appliance-specific malware and VPN-less AD lateral movement — patch-only remediation insufficient; perimeter VPN appliances remain tier-zero identity infrastructure.

CMMC Phase II suspension day 19 (DoW July 13, 2026): Reform Task Force 60-day review active; report due September 11; CMMC RFI comment window closes August 14; Phase I self-assessments, SPRS affirmations, and NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 controls remain in force — Defense Industry Profile must not defer SSP or POA&M updates during reform window; False Claims Act Civil Cyber-Fraud Initiative scrutiny continues.

FAR Council CUI proposed rule post-comment (comment period closed July 23, 2026): NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3 and 72-hour CUI incident reporting via clause 52.240-7 — Public Sector and Defense profiles must track dual Rev 2 CMMC self-assessment path and prospective Rev 3 FAR alignment without conflating assessment baselines.

Ironintel correlation priority August 1: Cisco FMC deadline-day triage, Minnesota PLC day-five recovery attestation, Cl0p Windchill PLM extortion wave, Balbooa Forms post-deadline verification, CMMC RFI countdown (13 days to August 14 close) — all external research bytes require Irongate DMZ validation before tenant CRM persistence.
